sn4.5:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati Isipatane migadāye ||
sn4.5:1.4: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || 2.
sn4.5:2.1: ham bhikkhave sabbapāsehi ye dibbā ye ca mānusā ||
sn4.5:2.2: Tumhe pi bhikkhave muttā sabbapāsehi ye dibbā ye ca mānusā
sn4.5:2.3: caratha bhikkhave cārikaṃ bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampakāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ || ||
sn4.5:2.5: desetha bhikkhave dhammam ādikalyāṇam majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāṇa-kalyāṇam || sāttham savyañjanaṃ kevala-paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetha || ||
sn4.5:2.6: Santi sattā apparajakkha-jātikā || assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti ||
sn4.5:2.8: Aham pi bhikkhave yena Uruvelā Senānigamo ten-upasaṅkamissāmi dhamma-desanāyā ti || || 3.
sn4.5:2.9: Atha kho Māro pāpimā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
